ui.settings.speech.speech_section.try_ag.role: Button in the speech panel error fallback
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.try_ag.tone: Plain imperative; no exclamation, no please.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.try_ag.length: Button label; one line, never wraps. English is 9 characters; keep it a short verb phrase of similar width.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.try_ag.note: Reloads only the speech panel after it threw an error.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.retry.role: Button beside a failed availability read
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.retry.tone: Plain imperative; no exclamation, no please.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.retry.length: Button label; one line, never wraps. English is 5 characters; keep it a short verb phrase of similar width.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.retry.note: Re-reads which voice provider is available.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speaks.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speaks.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 14 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speaks.note: Names which provider is currently producing the assistant's voice. The value is a provider name, or "Nothing yet".

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 12 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.note: Whether any voice provider can speak right now. The value is "Ready" or "No provider".

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.role: Inline error under a speech row
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 31 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.note: Shown when writing one speech setting fails. Appears next to the row that failed.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.role: Inline error under a speech row
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 31 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.the_se.note: Shown when restoring one speech setting to default fails.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.tone: Neutral noun phrase in sentence case.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.length: Section or list heading; one line, sentence case. English is 14 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.note: Heading of the section; same words as the sidebar entry.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.how_th.role: Description under the Speech voicing heading
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.how_th.tone: Plain, friendly second person; explains rather than commands.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.how_th.length: Wrapping paragraph in the settings content column (about 60-70 characters per line); no length cap, keep every fact. English is 46 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.how_th.note: One sentence. "Speaks aloud" means text-to-speech output, not microphone input.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.role: Alert shown when the speech registry read fails
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 36 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.speech.note: Whole sentence; a Retry button sits beside it.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.nothin.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.nothin.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 11 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.nothin.note: Shown when no provider has spoken. Lowercase-sentence fragment is fine in languages where that reads naturally.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.no_pro.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.no_pro.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 11 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.no_pro.note: No voice provider is configured or reachable. A provider is a speech service.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.role: Parenthesised suffix after a provider name in a ranked list
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.length: Part of a longer visible sentence, not standalone. English is 11 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.availa.note: Appended in brackets after a provider name, for example "OpenAI (available)". Keep the parentheses.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.not_av.role: Parenthesised suffix after a provider name in a ranked list
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.not_av.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.not_av.length: Part of a longer visible sentence, not standalone. English is 15 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.not_av.note: Appended in brackets after a provider name, for example "ElevenLabs (not available)". Keep the parentheses.

ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.role: Provider name in the speech provider list
ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.tone: Technical register; keeps product and protocol names exactly.
ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 12 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.note: "Radient Pass" is a product name (a paid pass); keep it as written.

ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.role: Provider name used when the resolver found none
ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.length: Field or row label above/beside a control; one line. English is 11 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_settings_model.note: Shown as the serving provider when nothing is available.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_b.role: Alert when the server is too old for the speech feature
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_b.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_b.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 101 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_b.note: Tells the user to update the server. "Voicing surface" means the speech-settings feature of the server.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_u.role: Alert when availability could not be read
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_u.tone: Neutral warning; says what happened and the next step, never blames the user.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_u.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 38 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.copy_u.note: Followed by the server error text on the same line, so end without extra punctuation concerns.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.ready.tone: Matter-of-fact state word; not a promise about the service.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.ready.length: Single-line status readout beside a value; truncates rather than wraps. English is 5 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.ready.note: A voice provider can speak now.

ui.settings.speech.speech_section.missin.role: Helper line under the speech settings
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.missin.tone: Calm, factual sentence; no blame, no alarm.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.missin.length: Inline message that wraps in an alert or helper line. English is 171 characters.
ui.settings.speech.speech_section.missin.note: {rows} is a comma-separated list of setting keys, not prose. The English singular says "that row" and plural "those rows". Plural: English has one/other only. ru needs few/many; ar needs zero/two/few/many; supply every arm your language requires and keep # where the number belongs.

placeholders.count: How many settings are missing; selects the singular or plural arm.
placeholders.rows: Comma-separated technical setting keys such as speech.voice.language; insert verbatim.
